# meshmsg v0.1.25

This release fixes a peer-directory outage on long-running daemons and raises the private message size limit.

## Presence recovery

- Fixes `listen`, `peers`, and alias resolution showing only the local node while messages from other peers still arrive. The separate presence gossip swarm could stay partitioned (or keep stale neighbors) after suspend/resume or network changes, so peer announcements stopped reaching the daemon.
- The daemon now detects a silent presence swarm: if the broadcast swarm has neighbors but no valid presence record has arrived for 90 seconds, it rejoins presence. Repair attempts are spaced at least 90 seconds apart.
- Presence rejoins now use live broadcast neighbors in addition to invite bootstrap peers, so recovery also works when the bootstrap peer is offline and on nodes created with `meshmsg init`.

## Larger private messages

- Raises the private/direct message body limit to 65,358 bytes, matching the broadcast body limit, so shared IPC frame budgets stay valid. The direct transport frame is bounded to the body maximum plus 2 KiB of metadata headroom.

## Compatibility

Local IPC remains protocol v4 and broadcast envelopes remain version 3. Peers running older versions can still exchange presence; private messages larger than the previous limit require both peers to run v0.1.25. Restart the daemon after upgrading.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.25 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.24...v0.1.25
